title: Extent of Employer's Responsibility for Migrant Domestic Worker's Medical Fees for Treatment Resulting from Worker's Social Activity during Personal Time-off
what_it_is: Extent of Employer's Responsibility for Migrant Domestic Worker's Medical Fees for Treatment Resulting from Worker's Social Activity during Personal Time-off

sections.label: MDW medical insurance requirements
sections.summary: Employers must buy medical insurance of at least $15,000 a year for MDW inpatient care and day surgery, and MOM is reviewing the coverage amount.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To help employers manage their MDWs' medical expenses, they are required to purchase medical insurance plans of at least $15,000 a year to pay for inpatient care and day surgery.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This is sufficient to cover about 95% of hospital bills incurred by MDWs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) is reviewing the minimum insurance coverage amount.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM has stepped in to help some MDW employers who face genuine financial difficulty, so that their MDWs could receive appropriate treatment even if their employers were not able to meet their obligations.

sections.label: Hospitalisation after doctor visit
sections.summary: She was hospitalised after detouring to see a doctor, and the bill came to about five figures.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: Nobody knew until she detoured to see a doctor.

sentences.speaker: Ms Tin Pei Ling (MacPherson)
sentences.text: She was sent to the hospital and was hospitalised; the bill came up to about five figures.

sections.label: Employers liable for MDW bills
sections.summary: Under the current framework, employers are liable for Migrant Domestic Workers' medical bills rather than externalising the costs onto taxpayers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Under the current framework, employers are liable for the Migrant Domestic Workers' medical bills as it is a more reasonable approach than to externalise such costs and impose them onto taxpayers, for example.

sections.label: MOM help for employers
sections.summary: MOM will try to help employers facing difficulties, and there are schemes and funds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Of course, there are extenuating circumstances in cases like the one the Member highlighted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, employers who face many difficulties, as the Member shared, MOM will try to help them out and there are schemes and funds.

sections.label: Ensuring workers get treatment
sections.summary: The aim is to ensure the worker is not denied appropriate treatment even if the employer cannot afford the full bill, and the medical insurance scheme is being reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Because what we are trying to do, is to make sure that the worker is not denied appropriate treatment, despite the fact that the employer may not be able to afford the full medical bill as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, on one hand, as I have shared earlier, we are reviewing the medical insurance scheme to see how best we can help more employers tackle issues with regard to medical bills related to their employees.
